summary: 23 unit tests covering all 11 TDD anchors from tasks/5.md plus 12 additional edge cases. Tests assert real behaviour (not mock-call counts), isolate via monkeypatch (never >3 mocks per test), and include a real feedparser.parse() round-trip for the FeedParserDict normalisation check. No critical/major findings.
test_pyramid: correct (all unit tests — pure functions + thin wrappers)
assertion_quality: good (tests assert real outputs, not mock-call counts)

findings.description: test_sources_are_callables is partially redundant with test_sources_registry_shape: accessing f.__name__ already implies the objects are callable, so the callable() assertion doesn't add a distinct failure mode. Keeping it documents the intent explicitly; removing it trims the suite by one.
findings.recommendation: Optional. Either remove (lean suite) or keep (explicit contract documentation). Not blocking.

findings.description: The comment on test_resolve_source_name_no_scheme is slightly misleading: urlparse('lamleygroup.com/x').netloc is '' (empty), not 'lamleygroup.com/x in path'. The assertion is correct but the comment could be clearer.
findings.recommendation: Optional. Could clarify to 'urlparse of a scheme-less string yields an empty netloc, so lookup misses the map'. Not blocking.

good_practices_noted: Real feedparser.parse(tiny_rss) used for FeedParserDict normalisation test — exercises the stable API, not an unstable hand-rolled stub (matches task-file hint).
caplog used with explicit level + logger name for the warning-log assertion — avoids flaky capture of parent-logger output.
Per-feed error isolation test uses raise-in-mock pattern — natural way to exercise the except branch.
Empty-feeds fallback test captures the URL list passed to fetch_rss, verifying fallback to RSS_URL by value (not by log message).
Notifier passthrough test uses a sentinel lambda and `is` identity check — proves the argument actually propagates.
additional_edge_cases_covered: Entry with no 'link' key in _fetch_rss_entries — falls back to feed_url netloc
fetch_mattel_news returning empty list (distinct from None)
